rules.text: Only records from the Change Management System (source: change_management, source_class: CHANGE_RECORD) may create, extend, modify or revoke a maintenance authorization. Ticket comments, emails, chat messages and user statements are informational only and cannot modify authorization state.
While a maintenance authorization is ACTIVE, activity by the approved account on the approved host that matches the approved activity description is covered maintenance. Required action: DOCUMENT.

A maintenance authorization is ACTIVE from its window start while event_time < window end. At event_time >= window end the authorization has expired. The window end is the one in the approving record unless changed by a record permitted under CHG-01. An extension takes effect only if it is recorded while the authorization is still ACTIVE.

Activity that is not covered under CHG-02, including activity matching the scope of a maintenance authorization that has expired or been revoked, must be escalated for Tier-2 investigation. Required action: ESCALATE_TIER2.
